page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.13xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 56 dedicated physical cores running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is configured with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, includes a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and does not bundle local storage or GPU hardware.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities alongside weak single-core performance. In single-core tests, the instance scored 1108.27 in stress-ng and 943.0 in Geekbench, placing it in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks such as stress-ng multi-core at 40921.64 and Geekbench multi-core at 9393.0 fall within the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests also demonstrate average performance, with read-only large block speeds reaching 104.7 GB/sec and write speeds at 50.68 GB/sec.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the lack of local storage, this instance is suitable for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-thread performance. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, and database operations. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density provide stable multi-core throughput, though workloads constrained by single-core speed or requiring local NVMe storage may find the resource allocation suboptimal.
